notes.title: The Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Is Live!
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]Pixeljam has always worked on multiple projects at once (with different teams), and the thing we've probably spent the most time on is a sequel to our 2008 browser game [b]Dino Run.  [/b]We made it right after Gamma Bros, and you could say it's what really solidified our path to full time game devs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25080169/5d81a15e7389bb67a1a0aad4d73cec0ae03f0fec.png"][/img][/p][p]It's pixel-art prehistoric multiplayer platformer with world-building tools included to let people create and share their own experiences.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been either dreaming, planning, developing or crowdfunding on it since 2012 or so. We finally have enough momentum to make a final push to get to Early Access release on Steam, and if you are curious about it, please [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixeljam/the-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign?ref=9aoxr8" style="button" buttoncolor="#00364a"]click here to check out the Kickstarter Campaign[/url] we just launched.[/p][p][/p][p]Everyone that backs it will get immediate access to the current [b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b], where you can explore & experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends:[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25080169/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Pixeljam's Upcoming Dino Run 2!
notes.content:
Hello All,

You may or may not know that we made a browser game 15 years ago called [b]Dino Run[/b]. This is the game we made right after Gamma Bros, and is what also kickstarted our official career in game development.

We are finally making a sequel and we have a coming soon page for it now.  Please wishlist it if it interests you:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590330/Dino_Run_2/

It's a multiplayer prehistoric platformer / runner with a lot of visuals customizations & user-made levels. You can keep up with its development via our [url=https://discord.gg/JM2MMUf]Discord[/url] server and also on [url=https://pixeljam.com/dinorun]pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url].

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/f12ea75201dc7c2b9e61c7e12e87ab3e47c9514e.png[/img]

notes.title: The OST + Supporter Pack DLC Is Live
notes.content:
Hello all,

We just launched the [b]Gamma Bros OST + Supporter Pack DLC[/b].  This contains the full soundtrack to the game, plus a "goodies" folder with additional GIFs, artwork, and some designs for the the potential sequel :)

You can find it here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/[/url]

notes.title: The Gamma Bros OST & Supporter Pack Launches October 21st
notes.content:
Hello all,

We're excited to announce that we're finally releasing the Gamma Bros soundtrack, plus a lot of  additional goodies, in the official [b]OST & Supporter Pack[/b] on October 21st.

The OST will contain all the music from the original game, plus some tracks that were created for Gamma Bros 1.5 but never made it into the game.

It will also have GIFs, wallpapers, artwork and a lot of concept sketches for sequels that were planned but never actually started (*sniff*).

We hope you enjoy it when it comes out!  If you want to wishlist it, go here -> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack[/url]

notes.title: -GAMMA BROS is now available to all for FREE-
notes.content:
We've released the game from Early Access, and it's now free for everyone to play.  This build should be stable, but if you encounter any issues, drop us a note in the forums.

Enjoy!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: Windows 10 "ANE" bug has been fixed + up/down control stick inversion option added.
notes.content:
If you have Windows 10, and the game wouldn't start because of an Adobe AIR bug, try it now - this should be fixed.

Current version is 1.2.

This also adds the ability to invert the Y axis, for some controllers that had trouble with it.

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: We're removing the ability to purchase Gamma Bros from Steam. Here's why.
notes.content:
When we started this project, we had high hopes for Gamma Bros.  Today marks 2 years since our last update to the game, which should easily explain how things didn't work out the way we wanted.

So, we are removing the ability to buy the game from the store.  If we are able to make an update to the game, we'll put it back on sale, but until then it doesn't seem right that anyone should pay full price (or even discounted price) for this.

If you bought the game already, feel free to get a refund through Steam if you want to.  If that's not possible, email us at pixeljamgames@gmail.com and we'll get you a Steam key for any other (completely finished) Pixeljam game that you want.

Thanks,

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: The State Of The Bros
notes.content:
Hello All,

I know it's been an extremely long time since the last update.  Here's what's going on:

1) Gamma Bros actually is still being worked on, if you can believe it.

2) The lack of game updates, or any sort of update is my fault, not the rest of the team - I got swallowed up by a side-project and by the time I emerged, WAY too much time had gone by.  It's a funny thing, that TIME.

3) We are going to share some progress on one of the major new features soon.  I won't say when because it probably won't be correct.

4) Everyone that bought the game has been incredibly patient and understanding, and I'm actually amazed no one has complained yet!

5) If you want a steam key for any (or all) of our other games, hit me up : miles@pixejlam.com  OR send a steam direct message to our account pixeljamgames.  (choose from Dino Run, Potatoman, Glork, Last Horizon).

That's it!  Thanks for reading... more updates to come.

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Early Access News #1!
notes.content:
Hello all,

Just giving a head's up on the slow but steady progress we're making on Gamma Bros...  we decided to work on one of the larger new features first, which is new playable characters: Buddy and Pooper (green dude and purple worm), and well as the orange "merchant".  Each character will change the dynamic of the game considerably.  It's more than just a new character to play the same game with...  more like new modes of play.

We'll show everyone something soon.  Thanks again for the support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Introducing The Roadmap To 1.5
notes.content:
Hello early adopters,

In an effort to give our path to full release a bit more transparency, we've created a visual roadmap to show you how we are doing on each major milestone to 1.5.  You can view the full version on [url]gammabros.com[/url], but here is a view of the current state if you don't feel like going there:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080169/8a5a4a7dd43907812022186baaa75f3d48ceb2ea.png[/img]

And here is our estimates on how long this will take:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080169/1c2761a551db64ae31221bba5324397ae5994289.png[/img]

We'll fill in the actual hours as we complete tasks.

Expect our first major update (a new build with added features) in about a month!

-Miles @ Pixeljam
